column3: Storable and Cacheable Content: static site, caching is intended (hashed /assets are immutable).
CSP script-src 'unsafe-eval': daemon core scripts are compiled with new Function inside their own locked-down Web Worker; no core code runs on the page.
SRI missing: the Google Fonts stylesheet is generated per user agent, so it cannot carry an integrity hash.
COEP missing: require-corp would block the cross-origin Google Fonts; the site does not need cross-origin isolation.
